# Workspace Agents

> Trigger published ChatGPT workspace agents from backend systems and automations.

Use this as a compact map of Workspace Agents docs. Each page has a Markdown twin at `/workspace-agents/<slug>.md`.

## Documentation sets
- [Combined Workspace Agents docs](https://developers.openai.com/workspace-agents/llms-full.txt): Single-file Markdown export of Workspace Agents docs.

## Authentication
- [Authenticate with Workspace Agent access tokens](https://developers.openai.com/workspace-agents/authentication.md): Provision and use bearer credentials for the Workspace Agents API.

## Trigger Runs
- [Trigger workspace agent runs](https://developers.openai.com/workspace-agents/trigger-runs.md): Kick off ChatGPT workspace agents from server-side systems or automations.
